narration: Your apps are running a psychological game against you. The average smartphone user loses $840 every year to tricks deliberately built into their favorite apps. And it's completely legal in America.
visual: Smartphone center-screen with animated dollar signs draining out of the display, red pulsing glow around the device. Text overlay: 'YOUR APPS ARE STEALING FROM YOU'. Subtext: '$840/YEAR AVERAGE'.

narration: It's called dark patterns — deliberate design that tricks you into spending money you never planned to. Ninety-five percent of top apps use at least one. Let's meet the three worst.
visual: Counter animating from 0% to 95% in large red numerals. Below it: a phone UI mockup showing a giant green 'YES — $9.99/MO' button alongside a tiny barely-visible 'no thanks, maybe later' link. Label: 'OF TOP APPS USE DARK PATTERNS'.

narration: Number one: the free trial auto-upgrade. The cancel button is buried two menus deep on purpose — because 73% of users get charged before they ever find it.
visual: A countdown timer ticking from 72:00:00 to 00:00:00. Below it, a credit card SVG. When the timer hits zero, 'CHARGED!' slams in with a red stamp. '73% NEVER CANCEL IN TIME' text below.

narration: Number two: confirm shaming. One button says 'Yes, sign me up!' in huge text. The other says 'No thanks, I don't want to save money' in tiny grey. Your guilt does the rest.
visual: Large green button 'YES, SIGN ME UP!' springs onto screen. Below it, a tiny grey text 'no thanks, i don't want to save money'. An upward arrow highlights the shame button. Label: 'CONFIRM SHAMING' in red.

narration: Number three: the impossible unsubscribe — five steps, then a phone call, then a guilt survey. The EU actually banned all three of these tricks in 2023. We haven't.
visual: Vertical flowchart showing cancellation steps: SETTINGS → ACCOUNT → MEMBERSHIP → CANCEL? (highlighted red) → CALL US → SURVEY. Each box springs in one by one. EU flag badge with 'BANNED 2023 ✓' appears at the end.

narration: Tonight, open your bank statement and find every subscription you don't remember signing up for. These three dark patterns are draining $840 a year from people exactly like you. Time to take it back.
visual: Simplified bank statement with rows appearing — some flagged in red with an X mark. A green shield SVG springs in showing '$840 RECLAIMED'. CTA button: 'AUDIT YOUR APPS TONIGHT' in red.
